law_name: Act CXII of 2011 on Informational Self-Determination and Freedom of Information (Infotv.)
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
enforcement_authority: Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH)
deceased_data: Rights of deceased may be exercised for 5 years after death by designated person or, failing that, a close relative (s. 25 Infotv)
research_exemption: Research data usable only for research; identifiers removed as soon as purpose allows; publication only with consent or if needed for historical results (quoted older wording; current Infotv text unconfirmed) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; separate Act XXI of 2008 on human genetic data, genetic studies/research and biobanks
notes: Infotv. as amended by Act XXXVIII of 2018 (in force 2018-07-26); regulator NAIH
